title: Research Paper Brief input
description: Shape of the JSON passed to scripts/build_brief.py. All fields optional; missing content renders as a 'Not reported' note so the seven-section shape is preserved.

citation.description: Short citation, e.g. 'Doe et al., Nature Neuroscience, 2024'.

hypothesis.description: Testable claim. Append '(implicit)' if not stated by the authors.

detail.description: One line: the how / key parameter / sample size.

procedure.description: Plain-words walkthrough of the method — the narrative companion to 'workflow'. Each item is one or two jargon-free sentences a non-specialist could follow, mirroring the workflow steps. Renders as a numbered list under the workflow flow.

outcomes.description: Headline result first, then the supporting numbers.

authors.description: The handful who did the core work.

institutes.description: Labs, universities, hospitals, or companies behind the work.

note.description: Optional. One or two sentences on what this paper means for your own work. Your interpretation, not content from the paper. Omit for papers with no relevance.
